extension.summary: The whole Earth: thirteen projections, live weather, day and night, and ASCII modes
extension.description: An ambient world-map screensaver. Shows the Earth in thirteen projections, from Mercator and Robinson to Fuller's Dymaxion, Peirce's quincuncial square, Waterman's butterfly (on his W5 polyhedron) and a spinning globe, with satellite, relief, OpenStreetMap or atlas base maps. Layers: infrared clouds, precipitation, temperature, flowing wind and tropical storms, the moving day/night line and city lights. Also draws the world as Dwarf Fortress-style ASCII art. Cycles projections and styles on a timer. Keeps working from cached data when the network drops.
extension.disclaimer: Data from NASA (Blue Marble, GIBS, GPM IMERG), NOAA (nowCOAST, NHC), GDACS, Open-Meteo.com (CC BY 4.0), Natural Earth and Mapzen terrain tiles. Map tiles © OpenStreetMap contributors, © CARTO. For personal use; follow each provider's terms.
